purpose: 策展句历史债·批1 逐字核证证据（imdb quotes / wikiquote 原文逐字）

verified.en: Hachi, my friend, Parker is never coming home. But if Hachiko wants to wait, then Hachiko should wait.
verified.note: Ken 对 Hachi 说明等待的意义；逐字摘自 IMDb quotes 页

verified.en: You are the first woman on the first day of creation. You are mother, sister, lover, friend, angel, devil, earth, home.
verified.note: Marcello 对 Sylvia 的告白；Wikiquote 逐字

verified.en: I really have nothing to say, but I want to say it anyway.
verified.note: 全片题眼台词；IMDb quotes 逐字

verified.en: I knew these people. These two people. They were in love with each other.
verified.note: 窥孔独白开场；Wikiquote 逐字。注意本片 extra 行已近似，主台词替换后需去重

verified.en: Everything can happen. Everything is possible and probable. Time and space do not exist. On a flimsy framework of reality, the imagination spins, weaving new patterns.
verified.note: 开场独白（IMDb 归属海伦娜）；IMDb quotes 逐字

verified.en: If I come in third, I'll give you the sneakers. ... I'll be third for sure.
verified.note: Ali 对妹妹 Zahra 的承诺，全片情感主线；IMDb quotes 逐字。zh 用对照翻译：'跑第三名，我把那双球鞋给你。/ 我肯定跑第三。'

verified.en: Madonna, Madonna, help me to change my life. Bestow your grace on me too. Make me change my life.
verified.note: 圣母游行祈祷段；IMDb quotes 逐字。zh 对照：'圣母啊，求你帮我改变生活，也赐我恩典。'

verified.en: Where am I? I don't seem to be anywhere. If death is like this, I don't think much of it. Everything's gone. People, trees, birds, wine. Well, up yours!
verified.note: 大雾场景；IMDb quotes 逐字。备选 Gradisca：'But affection is even more important than love. I'm so full of affection. But who can I give it to? Who wants it?'

verified.en: But affection is even more important than love. I'm so full of affection. But who can I give it to? Who wants it?
verified.note: 备选第二句（理发店独白收尾），可作为 extra 或与上句二选一

verified.en: I want one of those long encounters that last a lifetime. I want a family, children, a husband to chat with in the evenings over coffee. But affection is even more important than love. I'm so full of affection. But who can I give it to? Who wants it?
verified.note: 理发店独白（节选连续句）；IMDb quotes 逐字。zh 对照：'我想要一场相伴一生的相遇。我想要家、孩子，晚上能一起喝咖啡说话的丈夫。可比爱情更要紧的是感情，我心里满满都是情意，可是给谁呢？谁要呢？'

verified.en: The future is not a straight line. It is filled with many crossroads. There must be a future that we can choose for ourselves.
verified.note: 超能力少女开示段；IMDb quotes 逐字。zh 对照：'未来不是一条直线，它布满十字路口。一定有一个我们能亲手选择的未来。'

verified.en: To begin, you have to understand that this is a war. Everything in war is simple, but the simplest thing is difficult.
verified.note: 马蒂厄上校开讲段；IMDb quotes 逐字（'At first, you must understand that this is a war. Everything in war is simple, but the simplest thing is difficult.'——以 IMDb 页原文为准，落盘为节选）。zh 对照：'首先要明白，这是一场战争。战争中一切都简单，而最简单的事最困难。'

verified.en: It's hard to start a revolution. Even harder to continue it. And hardest of all to win it. But, it's only afterwards, when we have won, that the true difficulties begin.
verified.note: 开头段落；IMDb quotes 逐字。zh 对照：'革命难在开始，更难在坚持，最难在胜利。而真正的困难，是胜利之后才开始的。'

verified.en: Give us your bombers, and you can have our baskets.
verified.note: 备选短句（记者问答收尾）；IMDb quotes 逐字

verified.en: I studied philosophy, history of religion, aesthetics. And ended up putting myself in chains. Of my own free will.
verified.note: 开场独白；IMDb quotes 逐字。zh 对照：'我研究哲学、宗教史、美学，最后却给自己戴上了枷锁——出于我自己的自由意志。'

verified.en: Are you not human? What are you?
verified.note: 源十郎对若狭的质问段。zh 对照：'你不是人吗？你到底是什么？'

verified.en: I'm going to build an opera house in Iquitos and Caruso'll open it.
verified.source: Kinobot 字幕转写 kino.caretas.club + IMDb quotes tt0083946
verified.note: 全片题眼（雨林歌剧院宣言）；Kinobot 转写逐字。zh 对照：'我要在伊基托斯建一座歌剧院，由卡鲁索来开幕。'
